foods.name: Cardamom seed, dried, ground
foods.description: Ground spice commonly used in Indian cooking and drinks, in Middle Eastern cooking and in Scandinavian baking

foods.name: Cinnamon, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground bark or quills of Cinnamomum verum, C. zeylanicum or C. aromaticum, used as a spice.

foods.name: Chilli (chili), dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground red pepper, characterised by a hot sensation when consumed as a spice.

foods.name: Cloves, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground, unopened flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum, used as a spice.

foods.name: Coriander seed, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground fruit or seed of Coriandrum sativum, used as a spice.

foods.name: Cumin (cummin) seed, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground fruit or seeds of Cuminum cymimum, used as a spice.

foods.name: Curry powder
foods.description: Dried and ground mixture of spices for use in the preparation of Indian-style meals. Typical ingredients include the spices cumin, coriander seed and turmeric.

foods.name: Fenugreek seed, dried
foods.description: Dried fenugreek seeds used as a spice.

foods.name: Ginger, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground rhizome of Zingiber officinale, used as a spice.

foods.name: Mustard powder
foods.description: Dry powder composed of ground yellow mustard seeds, for use in preparation of mustard paste or incorporation into other foods.

foods.name: Nutmeg, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground seed of Myristica fragrans (M. officinalis or M. aromatica), used as a spice.

foods.name: Oregano, dried
foods.description: Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Oreganum vulgare, used as a culinary herb.

foods.name: Paprika, dry powder
foods.description: Dried and ground fruit of red capsicums (sweet red peppers).

foods.name: Pepper, black, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground unripe fruit of the pepper tree (Piper nigrum), used as a spice.

foods.name: Rosemary, dried
foods.description: Dried woody herb with fragrant needle-like green leaves on small stalks.

foods.name: Sage, dried
foods.description: Dry leaves of Salvia officinalis used as a herb.

foods.name: Thyme, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Thymus vulgaris, used as a culinary herb.

foods.name: Turmeric, dried, ground
foods.description: Dried and ground rhizome of Curcuma domestica or C. longa, used as a spice.

foods.name: Salt substitute, potassium chloride
foods.description: Product sold as a replacement for regular table salt, containing predominantly potassium chloride.

foods.name: Salt, table, iodised
foods.description: Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods, to which iodine has been added in the form of potassium iodate or iodide. May contain free-flowing agents.

foods.name: Salt, table, non-iodised
foods.description: Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods. May contain free-flowing agents and small amounts of other minerals such as potassium.

foods.name: Stock, dry powder or cube
foods.description: Concentrated meat stock that is dried and supplied as a powder or compressed into a cube. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

foods.name: Stock, liquid, all flavours (except fish), prepared from commercial powder or cube
foods.description: Savoury liquid prepared by diluting commercial stock powder or cubes with water. Can be consumed alone, or used as an ingredient to flavour recipes. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

foods.name: Taco seasoning mix, chilli-based
foods.description: Powdered product intended for addition to meat and other ingredients to prepare Mexican-style dishes such as taco filling. Typical ingredients include salt, sugar, maize starch, spices, chilli and citric acid.

foods.name: Baking powder, dry powder
foods.description: Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes. Composed of 50% cream of tartar, 25% baking soda, and 25% starch.

foods.name: Baking soda (bicarbonate), dry powder
foods.description: Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes.

foods.name: Cream of tartar, dry powder
foods.description: Purified, crystallised potassium bitartrate, used as the acid component of some fast acting baking powder mixtures.

foods.name: Lecithin, soy, granules
foods.description: Phospholipid-rich granular extract of soy beans, often used in baking and as an emulsifier, as purchased from supermarkets for domestic use.

foods.name: Gelatine, all types
foods.description: Unflavoured light yellow granular proteinaceous powder. Used to sweeten and thicken soups, sauces and desserts.

foods.name: Vanilla, artificial or imitation
foods.description: Solution containing the substance vanillin, used as a flavouring agent.

foods.name: Vanilla bean extract
foods.description: Alcoholic extract of the vanilla bean (Vanilla plantifolia or V. tahitensis), used as a flavouring agent.

foods.name: Yeast, dry powder
foods.description: A cream or pale grey powder with a fine, smooth texture. Active raising agent used domestically to leaven a wide range of breads, cakes and pastries.

foods.name: Beer, high alcohol (5% v/v & above)
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using warm temperature fermentation. Greater than or equal to 5% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Beer, full strength (alcohol 4-4.9% v/v)
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using low fermentation temperatures. Alcohol content between 4-4.9% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Beer, full strength (alcohol 4-4.9% v/v), carbohydrate modified
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), resulting in lower final carbohydrate levels than regular beer.  Alcohol content between 4 - 4.9% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Beer, mid-strength (alcohol 3-3.9% v/v)
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as mid strength. Alcohol content between 3-3.9% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Beer, light (alcohol 1-2.9% v/v)
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as Light or Lite. Alcohol content between 1- less than 3% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~30% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky), cooked
foods.description: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products, that has been heated until a large proportion of alcohol has evaporated.

foods.name: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
foods.description: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products.

foods.name: Cider, apple (alcohol ~4-5% v/v)
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented apples with significant residual sugars. Includes cider produced in Australia, New Zealand and Denmark. Approximately 4% alcohol.

foods.name: Mirin
foods.description: Commercially prepared rice based sweet cooking wine, commonly used in Japanese style cooking.

foods.name: Wine, red
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, cabernet sauvignon
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the cabernet sauvignon grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, merlot
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the merlot grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, pinot noir
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the pinot noir grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, shiraz
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the shiraz grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia only. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, sparkling
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from red wine grapes, retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, red, cooked
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with grape skins, that has been heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.

foods.name: Wine, rose
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice so that the wine has a pale pink colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, sauvignon blanc
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the sauvignon blanc grape, produced with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, semillon
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the semillon grape, produced with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia only. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, chardonnay
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice produced from the chardonnay grape, with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, riesling
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice produced from the riesling grape, with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with some sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, produced with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, cooked
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with little contact with grape skins, then heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.

foods.name: Wine, white, sparkling
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice produced with little grape skin contact so that the wine is pale yellow in colour and retains significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Includes wine described as brut or semi-brut in style produced in Australia and France. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, white, sweet dessert style
foods.description: Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice with little grape skin contact, so that the wine is golden in colour and retains a high level of residual sugars (approximately 10% sugars). Includes botrytised wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 10% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, fortified, port
foods.description: Sweet, alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Approximately 16% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, fortified, sherry, dry style (~1% sugars)
foods.description: Fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added and with a low sugars content (approximately 1%). Approximately 18% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Wine, fortified, sherry, sweet style (~11% sugars)
foods.description: Fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Approximately 14% v/v alcohol.

foods.name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Milo)
foods.description: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids and cocoa. Contains added iron, calcium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D. Milo brand is an example of such a product.

foods.name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, unfortified (Nesquik brand)
foods.description: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, cocoa, soy lecithin and salt. No added vitamins or minerals.

foods.name: Beverage base, drinking chocolate, unfortified
foods.description: Unfortified powdered mixture of sugar and cocoa or chocolate used for mixing with milk or water to produce a beverage. Other ingredients may include maltodextrin, milk solids, soy lecithin, salt, flavour.

foods.name: Cocoa powder
foods.description: Powder produced from the liquor extracted from cocoa beans. Typically used to flavour beverages and in baking.

foods.name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, from Milo powder, with regular fat cow's milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared by mixing milo powder with regular fat cows milk.

foods.name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, from Nesquik powder, with regular fat cow's milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared by mixing chocolate Nesquik powder with regular fat cow's milk.

foods.name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, from drinking chocolate, with regular fat cow's milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared by mixing drinking chocolate powder with regular fat cows milk.

foods.name: Protein powder, hemp seed based
foods.description: Commercially prepared protein powder from the hulled hempseed after the oil has been extracted, milled into powder and much of fibre removed by sieving to get concentrated protein. Product of New Zealand and imported.

foods.name: Protein powder, whey based, protein >70%, unfortified
foods.description: White powder prepared from cows milk by refining and dehydrating the whey component to achieve a protein content of greater than 70%. Does not contain added flavours, vitamins or minerals.

foods.name: Protein powder, whey based, protein >70%, unfortified, prepared with water
foods.description: Beverage prepared by mixing whey based protein powder with water.

foods.name: Coffee, instant, dry powder or granules
foods.description: Dried extract of coffee beans, used to produce a beverage by the addition of boiling water.

foods.name: Coffee, instant, dry powder or granules, decaffeinated
foods.description: Dried extract of decaffeinated coffee beans, used to produce a beverage by the addition of boiling water.

foods.name: Coffee mix, with beverage whitener & sugar, dry powder
foods.description: Dry product that is a mixture of ingredients such as milk solids, sugar, vegetable oil, maltodextrin and coffee (around 13%), used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

foods.name: Coffee, prepared from coffee mix with sugar & whitener, no added milk
foods.description: Beverage made from dry coffee mix with sugar and whitener to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added milk or flavour.

foods.name: Coffee, black, from instant coffee powder
foods.description: Beverage made from instant coffee powder or granules to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

foods.name: Coffee, black, from instant coffee powder, decaffeinated
foods.description: Beverage made from instant decaffeinated coffee powder or granules to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

foods.name: Coffee, espresso, from ground coffee beans
foods.description: Beverage prepared from ground coffee beans and a small amount of hot water, as purchased in takeaway outlets or restaurants. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

foods.name: Coffee, long black, from ground coffee beans
foods.description: Beverage prepared from ground coffee beans to which a large volume of hot water is added. Does not contain added milk, sugar, or flavour.

foods.name: Coffee, flat white/latte/cappuccino, from ground coffee beans, with regular fat cow's milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared from a serve of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated regular fat cows milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

foods.name: Cordial base, 25% citrus fruit juice, regular
foods.description: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing a minimum of 25% citrus fruit juice (typically orange or lemon juice), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

foods.name: Cordial base, 40% citrus fruit juice, regular
foods.description: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 40% citrus fruit juice (typically orange or lemon juice), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

foods.name: Cordial base, blackcurrant juice, regular
foods.description: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing a minimum of 5% blackcurrant juice, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

foods.name: Cordial base, fruit juice/flavours, intense sweetened or diet
foods.description: Concentrated syrup containing fruit juice or fruit flavour and intense sweeteners (acesulphame potassium, cyclamate, sucralose).

foods.name: Cordial, 25% citrus fruit juice, regular, recommended dilution
foods.description: Non-alcoholic beverage prepared by mixing 1 part of a concentrated sugar syrup containing 25% citrus fruit juice with 4 parts of water.

foods.name: Cordial, 40% citrus fruit juice, regular, recommended dilution
foods.description: Non-alcoholic beverage prepared by mixing 1 part of a concentrated sugar syrup containing 40% non-citrus fruit juice with 4 parts of water.

foods.name: Cordial, blackcurrant juice, regular, recommended dilution
foods.description: Non-alcoholic beverage prepared by mixing 1 part of a concentrated sugar syrup containing blackcurrant juice with 5 parts of water.

foods.name: Cordial, fruit juice/flavours, recommended dilution
foods.description: Non-alcoholic beverage prepared by mixing 1 part of a concentrated sugar syrup containing fruit juice or flavour with 6 parts of water.

foods.name: Cordial, fruit juice/flavours, intense sweetened or diet, recommended dilution
foods.description: Non-alcoholic beverage prepared by mixing 1 part of a concentrated fruit juice/flavouring based syrup, sweetened with intense sweeteners (acesulphame potassium, cyclamate, sucralose) rather than sugar, with 9 parts of water.

foods.name: Juice, apple, commercial, added vitamin C
foods.description: Commercial beverage prepared by crushing apples and filtering or clarifying the resultant juice. Contains added vitamin C. Does not contain added sugar.

foods.name: Juice, apple & blackcurrant, commercial
foods.description: Commercial beverage prepared from crushed apples and blackcurrants. Does not contain added sugar.

foods.name: Juice, lemon
foods.description: Commercial or homemade liquid prepared from the endocarp of lemons.

foods.name: Juice, lime
foods.description: Commercial or homemade liquid prepared from the endocarp of limes.

foods.name: Juice, orange, commercial
foods.description: Commercial beverage which is prepared from the endocarp of oranges. Contains added vitamin C, but does not contain added sugar.

foods.name: Juice, orange & mango, commercial
foods.description: Commercial beverage prepared from 95% orange juice and 5% mango juice. Contains added vitamin C, but does not contain added sugar.

foods.name: Juice, vegetable blend, commercial
foods.description: Commercial beverage prepared from tomato, carrot, sweet potato, celery, beetroot and other vegetable juices. Contains added salt, but no added sugar.

foods.name: Fruit drink, apple juice
foods.description: Commercially prepared product made from 20-35% apple juice, water, sugars and food acids. May contain added vitamin C.

foods.name: Fruit drink, blackcurrant, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared beverage made from approximately 6% blackcurrant juice, water, sugar and food acid. Contains added vitamin C.

foods.name: Fruit drink, cranberry
foods.description: Commercially prepared beverage made from 25% cranberry juice, water, sugar and food acid. May contain added vitamin C.

foods.name: Fruit drink, orange juice
foods.description: Commercially prepared beverage made from 25% orange juice, water, sugar and food acid. Does not contain added vitamin C.

foods.name: Soft drink, cola flavour
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, sugar, cola flavour, caffeine and colours.

foods.name: Soft drink, cola flavour, decaffeinated
foods.description: Decaffeinated, carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, sugar, cola flavour.

foods.name: Soft drink, cola flavour, intense sweetened or diet
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, intense sweeteners, cola flavour, caffeine and colours.

foods.name: Soft drink, cola flavour, intense sweetened or diet, decaffeinated
foods.description: Decaffeinated, carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, intense sweeteners, cola flavour and colours.

foods.name: Soft drink, dry ginger ale or ginger beer, regular
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, sugar, and colours.

foods.name: Soft drink, fruit flavours
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, sugar and citric acid.

foods.name: Soft drink, tonic water
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water and sugar with added quinine.

foods.name: Soft drink, fruit flavours, intense sweetened or diet
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, intense sweetener, fruit flavours and colours.

foods.name: Soft drink, tonic water, intense sweetened or diet
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water and intense sweetener with added quinine.

foods.name: Soft drink, energy drink, Red Bull
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic water-based flavoured beverage containing added caffeine, taurine, glucuronolactone, inositol, niacinamide, pantothenic acid, vitamins B6 and B12.

foods.name: Soft drink, energy drink, V
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic water-based flavoured beverage containing added caffeine, taurine, guarana, inositol, glucuronolactone, pantothenic acid, vitamins B2, B3, B6 and B12. May also contain ginkgo biloba extract.

foods.name: Kombucha, flavoured, added juice or intense sweeteners
foods.description: Beverage prepared by the fermentation of green or black tea with a combination of yeast and bacteria. Contains intense sweeteners and added flavours such as fruit juice. Ready to drink.

foods.name: Tea, regular, black, brewed from leaf or teabags, without milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared by brewing black tea leaves (dried, fermented leaves of Camellia sinensis) in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Tea is not decaffeinated or flavoured. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

foods.name: Tea, black, brewed from leaf or teabags, decaffeinated
foods.description: Beverage prepared by brewing black decaffeinated tea leaves (dried, fermented leaves of Chrysanthemum species) in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.

foods.name: Tea, green, plain, without milk
foods.description: Beverage prepared by brewing green, unfermented tea leaves in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.

foods.name: Mineral water, natural, unflavoured
foods.description: Carbonated or naturally sparkling ground water obtained from subterranean water-bearing strata that, in its natural state, contains soluble matter. No added sugar or flavours.

foods.name: Mineral water, citrus flavoured
foods.description: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing 5% citrus juice (orange and lemon), mineral water and sugar.

foods.name: Water, bottled, still
foods.description: Still, non-carbonated water bottled prior to sale. May include spring water.

foods.name: Water, soda
foods.description: Carbonated water.

foods.name: Water, tap
foods.description: Water as supplied through the municipal water system. Values are approximations of those reported across Australia, and may vary according to location or time of year.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, corn cake, plain, salted
foods.description: Commercially prepared, round or square, savoury dry cake, made from puffed corn and salted.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, rice cracker, plain
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury biscuit made predominantly from rice flour, with added salt and/or 'original' flavours.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, rice cracker, added vegetable powder
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury biscuit made predominantly from rice, containing vegetable powders and added flavourings.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, rice cake, from brown rice, plain
foods.description: Commercially prepared, round or square, savoury dry cake, approximately 1 cm thick, made from brown puffed rice. Does not contain added flavour. May contain added salt.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, rice cracker, flavoured (excluding seaweed)
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury biscuit made predominantly from rice flour, with added seaweed flavourings.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, rice cracker, seaweed flavoured
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury biscuit made predominantly from rice flour, with added seaweed flavourings.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from rye flour, crispbread
foods.description: A thin, flat rectangle of dry bread made predominantly from rye flour. Commercially prepared; some brands may include a proportion of wheat flour.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, seed based
foods.description: Savoury biscuit based predominately on seeds (e.g. linseed, pumpkin seed, poppy seed, sesame seed) with added salt.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, flaky cracker style
foods.description: Commercially prepared, square, plain savoury biscuit made from white wheat flour, with a flaky or layered texture.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, plain snack cracker style
foods.description: Commercially prepared, small, plain savoury biscuit made from white wheat flour and added fat, sprinkled with salt.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, Salada style
foods.description: Commercially prepared square biscuits made from white wheat flour with added fat and sprinkled with salt.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, water cracker style
foods.description: Commercially prepared round, savoury biscuits made from white wheat flour and water.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, cheese-flavoured
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury small biscuit made from white wheat flour, with added fat and cheese flavourings.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, flavoured (excluding cheese)
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury small biscuit made from white wheat flour, with added fat and flavourings other than cheese.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from wholemeal wheat flour, crispbread
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury thin, flat, biscuit made from wholemeal wheat flour (plain varieties).

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from wholemeal wheat flour & rye flour, crispbread, puffed
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury thin, flat rectangle of puffed, toasted dry bread made from wholemeal wheat flour, some with added bran, malt or rye.

foods.name: Biscuit, savoury, from wheat flour, crispbread, puffed & toasted
foods.description: A thin, flat rectangle of puffed, toasted dry bread made from white wheat flour.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, Anzac style, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet crunchy oat based biscuit. Typical ingredients include rolled oats, wheat flour, coconut and golden syrup.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, Anzac style, homemade from basic ingredients
foods.description: Home prepared crunchy oat biscuit prepared from common household ingredients including rolled oats, wheat flour, coconut, fat and golden syrup.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, ginger flavoured, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet crunchy ginger flavoured biscuits.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, plain
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet plain biscuit, made without added flavourings, chocolate, fruit or nuts.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, plain, with icing, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared, crisp sweet biscuit topped with sugar-based icing. Predominant ingredients are white wheat flour, sugar, animal or vegetable fats, salt and chemical leavening.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, shortbread style, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared shortbread-style biscuits. Ingredients may include butter, wheat flour, sugar and rice flour.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, wheatmeal
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit made from wheat flour with added wheatmeal.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, biscuit base, caramel filling, chocolate-coated, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit, generally chocolate flavoured, sandwiched with caramel filling and coated in chocolate.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, biscuit base, mint filling, chocolate-coated
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit, generally chocolate flavoured, sandwiched with sweetened creamy mint filling and coated in chocolate.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, chocolate chip or coated
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit with added chocolate chips or coating.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, chocolate chip, homemade from basic ingredients, fat not further defined
foods.description: Home prepared sweet biscuit baked with chocolate chips embedded in the biscuit dough. Made from common household ingredients including wheat flour, chocolate chips, sugar, fat and eggs.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, chocolate flavoured, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared crunchy chocolate flavoured biscuit, commonly containing wheat flour, sugar, cocoa, fats, and eggs.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, cream filled, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit, sandwiched with various sweetened flavoured creamy filling.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, sandwich, cream & jam filling
foods.description: Commercially prepared, non-chocolate flavoured sweet biscuit sandwiched with jam and sweetened creamy filling.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, sandwich, cream filling, chocolate-coated, tim tam style
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet biscuit, generally chocolate flavoured, sandwiched with sweetened creamy filling and coated in chocolate.

foods.name: Biscuit, sweet, breakfast style, with or without dried fruit
foods.description: A cereal based snack-style biscuit. Major ingredients vary between brands and varieties but tend to be mostly wheat and oat based, and may include fruit pieces, honey, nuts and compound chocolate.

foods.name: Cone, wafer style, for ice cream
