foods.name: Oats, rolled, mixed with sugar or honey & other flavours, uncooked
foods.description: Quick cooking rolled oats, sold mixed with honey and sugar and other flavours to be used to prepare a hot, porridge-style breakfast dish. Uncooked.

foods.name: Psyllium, uncooked
foods.description: Husk of a small seed which is high in dietary fibre. Uncooked

foods.name: Quinoa, black, uncooked
foods.description: Small black seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked

foods.name: Quinoa, red, uncooked
foods.description: Small rusty red seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked

foods.name: Quinoa, white, uncooked
foods.description: Small beige seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked

foods.name: Quinoa, uncooked
foods.description: Small beige, red or black seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour.

foods.name: Quinoa, cooked in water, no added salt
foods.description: Small beige seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat, oil or salt.

foods.name: Rye, grain, whole, uncooked
foods.description: Small, oval-shaped brown grains. Uncooked, unmilled.

foods.name: Rye, rolled, uncooked
foods.description: Crushed grain produced by steaming and flattening with hot rollers. Uncooked.

foods.name: Sorghum, grain, uncooked
foods.description: Small, round grain that is orange-red in colour. Can be milled into flour or kibbled (cut into) 3 or 4 pieces.

foods.name: Teff, uncooked
foods.description: A very small grass seed which is white to a deep reddish brown in colour. Typically ground and used to make traditional flat bread such as injera. Uncooked.

foods.name: Triticale, grain, uncooked
foods.description: A beige coloured, long, oval-shaped grain that is a wheat-rye hybrid. Can be milled into flour or kibbled (cut) into 3 or 4 pieces.

foods.name: Semolina, uncooked
foods.description: Coarsely ground starchy product from the inner endosperm of durum wheat. It is granular in appearance and ranges from clear to yellow in colour. Uncooked.

foods.name: Semolina, boiled, no added fat or salt
foods.description: Coarsely ground starchy product from the inner endosperm of durum wheat. It is granular in appearance and ranges from clear to yellow in colour. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat or salt.

foods.name: Spelt, uncooked
foods.description: Small uncooked grain from the wheat family. Uncooked.

foods.name: Spelt, boiled, no added fat or salt
foods.description: Small uncooked grain from the wheat family. Uncooked.

foods.name: Tapioca, pearl or seed style, uncooked
foods.description: Starchy product from the cassava plant supplied in the form of small pellets (also known as seeds or pearls). Sometimes sold labelled as Sago tapioca or Sago. Imported into Australia. Uncooked.

foods.name: Tapioca, pearl or seed style, boiled, no added fat or salt
foods.description: Starchy product supplied in the form of small pellets (also known as seeds or pearls). Sometimes sold labelled as Sago tapioca or Sago. Cooked by boiling according to label instructions.

foods.name: Wheat bran, unprocessed, uncooked
foods.description: Outer layers of the wheat grain which are removed during the early stages of milling, and do not undergo further processing other than packaging. Maybe coarsely or finely milled. Uncooked.

foods.name: Wheat, whole, uncooked
foods.description: Whole wheat grain including the bran, germ and endosperm.

foods.name: Wheat germ
foods.description: Small creamy flakes milled from the core of the wheat kernel.

foods.name: Rice, white, uncooked
foods.description: Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. The grains after milling have a slight off-white colour. Uncooked.

foods.name: Rice, white, boiled or rice cooker, no added salt
foods.description: Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. Cooked by boiling on the stove top or in an electric rice cooker in unsalted water.

foods.name: Rice, white, purchased as 'instant', microwaved
foods.description: Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. Pre-cooked before purchase, then heated in the microwave.

foods.name: Rice, brown, uncooked
foods.description: Grain with only the inedible outer husk removed. The bran coating gives it a light tan colour. Uncooked.

foods.name: Rice, brown, boiled, no added salt
foods.description: Grain with only the inedible outer husk removed. Cooked by boiling in unsalted water.

foods.name: Rice, wild, uncooked
foods.description: A long-grain marsh grass. Uncooked.

foods.name: Rice, wild, boiled, no added salt
foods.description: A long-grain marsh grass. Cooked by boiling in unsalted water.

foods.name: Rice paper wrapper, soaked in water
foods.description: Thin edible paper used to prepare rice paper rolls or summer rolls, typically made from rice flour, salt and water. Sold dried in thin, translucent round or square sheets that are crisp to the touch. Soaked in water with no added oil or salt. Does not contain any fillings.

foods.name: Rice, white, fried with bacon or ham, egg, prawns & vegetables
foods.description: Commercially prepared fried rice with egg, ham or pork, prawns, peas and shallots, ready to eat. As purchased from Chinese restaurants.

foods.name: Flour, arrowroot
foods.description: Flour ground from the starchy roots of a number of tropical plants.

foods.name: Flour, cornflour, from maize starch
foods.description: Fine white powder extracted from the starchy endosperm of maize (corn).

foods.name: Flour, cornflour, from maize & wheat starch
foods.description: Fine white powder extracted from the starchy endosperm of maize (corn) or wheat. Sold in Australia under the name of cornflour.

foods.name: Flour, chickpea (besan)
foods.description: Flour prepared from dried, ground chick peas.

foods.name: Flour, gluten free, plain
foods.description: Flour mix prepared from white gluten free starches and flours including rice, tapioca and corn/maize.

foods.name: Flour, rice
foods.description: Flour ground from grains of white and/or brown rice.

foods.name: Flour, rye
foods.description: A flour made from the milled wholegrain of rye.

foods.name: Flour, soya (soy)
foods.description: Creamy, finely ground flour processed from soya beans.

foods.name: Flour, spelt
foods.description: Flour prepared from ground spelt, a type of wheat.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, white, high protein or bread making flour
foods.description: High protein wheat flour which may contain added gluten to achieve a protein content ranging from 12-16%. Suitable for use in bread making. Contains added thiamin and folic acid.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, white, plain
foods.description: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. No added vitamins,  minerals or leavening agents.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, white, plain, added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E & folate & Fe, Mg & Zn (Jackaroo)
foods.description: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Specifically formulated in conjunction with the Northern Territory Government. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E and folate, iron, magnesium and zinc.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, white, self-raising
foods.description: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Chemical leavening agents added. No added vitamins or minerals.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, white, self-raising, added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E & folate & Fe, Mg & Zn (Jackaroo)
foods.description: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Specifically formulated in conjunction with the Northern Territory Government. Contains added chemical leavening agents and vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E and folate, iron, magnesium and zinc.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, wholemeal, plain
foods.description: Flour milled from whole wheat grain (bran, germ and flour). No added vitamins, minerals or leavening agents.

foods.name: Flour, wheat, wholemeal, self-raising
foods.description: Flour milled from whole wheat grain (bran, germ and flour) to which chemical leavening agents have been added. No added vitamins or minerals.

foods.name: Gluten, from wheat (vital wheat gluten)
foods.description: Protein rich extract of wheat flour.

foods.name: Starch, potato
foods.description: Fine powder composed of polysaccharides derived from the potato tuber.

foods.name: Hamburger, white roll, beef patty, with cheese, onion, pickles & sauce, fast food chain
foods.description: Commercially prepared hamburger containing a grilled beef burger patty, with processed cheese, pickles, sauce and onion in white bread roll, as served in fast food chains.

foods.name: Hamburger, white roll, beef patty, with salad, independent takeaway outlet
foods.description: Commercially prepared hamburger containing a grilled or pan fried beef burger patty and salad in a white bread roll, as served from an independent takeaway outlet.

foods.name: Hot dog, bread roll, frankfurt & sauce filling
foods.description: Fresh bread or bread roll containing a frankfurt, sauce and/or mustard.

foods.name: Pizza, cheese & tomato, commercial
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce and cheese. Includes frozen, fast food and takeaway styles.

foods.name: Pizza, ham & pineapple, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce, cheese, ham and/or bacon, with or without pineapple, frozen before packaging and reheated prior to consumption.

foods.name: Pizza, ham & pineapple, takeaway style
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce, cheese, ham and pineapple. Purchased ready to eat from independent takeaway food outlets.

foods.name: Pizza, supreme, takeaway style
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce, cheese, sausage, capsicum, onion, ham, anchovies, olives, beef, mushrooms and sometimes prawns. Purchased ready to eat from independent takeaway or fast food outlets.

foods.name: Pizza, supreme, fast food chain
foods.description: Commercially produced thick pizza dough typically topped with tomato-based sauce, cheese, ground beef, mushrooms, onion, capsicum, pepperoni, pineapple and ham/bacon. Purchased ready to eat from fast food outlets.

foods.name: Pizza, supreme, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce, cheese, sausage, capsicum, onion, ham, mushrooms and sometimes olives and beef, frozen before packaging and reheated prior to consumption.

foods.name: Pizza, vegetable, fast food chain
foods.description: Commercially produced pizza dough topped with tomato-based sauce and a mixture of vegetables. Purchased ready to eat from fast food outlets.

foods.name: Noodle, rice stick, boiled, drained
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodles made from a paste of water and ground rice, or rice with cornflour, which are then dried and coiled. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt and then drained.

foods.name: Noodle, soba, dry
foods.description: Commercially prepared dry noodles made from a mix of wheat and buckwheat flour. Uncooked.

foods.name: Noodle, soba, boiled, drained
foods.description: Commercially prepared dry noodles made from a mix of wheat and buckwheat flour, boiled in unsalted water and then drained.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, fresh, soaked, drained
foods.description: Commercially prepared, moist, wheat based noodle, commonly used in Asian style cooking. Includes noodles described as Hokkien, Singapore and Chow Mein noodles. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, flavoured, dry, uncooked
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Includes contents of flavour sachet. Uncooked.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, unflavoured, boiled, drained
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Cooked by heating in boiling water without contents of flavour sachet. Drained of excess water.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, unflavoured, boiled, undrained
foods.description: Noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Cooked by heating in boiling water. Undrained of excess water.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, unflavoured, dry, uncooked
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Does not include contents of flavour sachet. Uncooked.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, flavoured, boiled, drained
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Cooked by heating in boiling water with contents of flavour sachet. Drained of excess water.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat, instant, flavoured, boiled, undrained
foods.description: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Cooked by heating in boiling water with contents of favour sachet. Undrained of excess water.

foods.name: Noodle, wheat with egg, plain, boiled, no added fat
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt.

foods.name: Pasta, gluten free, boiled from dry, no added salt
foods.description: The dough made from grains other than wheat such as corn and rice with added water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta, legume based, boiled, no added salt
foods.description: The dough is made by combining legume flour (pea, chickpea, soy bean, bean, and/or lentil) with water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour, dry
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour, boiled from dry, no added salt
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (usually durum semolina) with water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour, fresh, uncooked
foods.description: Commercial product prepared from white wheat flour and other ingredients and cut to shape, but not dried prior to packaging. Includes fresh pasta containing egg. Uncooked.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour, fresh, boiled, no added salt
foods.description: Commercial product prepared from white wheat flour and other ingredients and cut to shape, but not dried prior to packaging. Includes fresh pasta containing egg. Boiled without added salt or fat, although the pasta itself is likely to contain added salt.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour & egg, dry
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. The dough is then dried prior to sale.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour & egg, boiled from dry, no added salt
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour & spinach, dry
foods.description: The dough made by combining white wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with water and spinach. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Uncooked.

foods.name: Pasta, white wheat flour & spinach, boiled from dry, no added salt
foods.description: The dough made by combining white wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with water and spinach. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta, wholemeal wheat flour, dry
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour (with varying proportions of whole-wheat grain and white flour) or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Uncooked.

foods.name: Pasta, wholemeal wheat flour, boiled from dry, no added salt
foods.description: The dough made by combining wheat flour (with varying proportions of whole-wheat grain and white flour) or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

foods.name: Pasta in cream based sauce, dry mix
foods.description: Commercially packaged product that contains dry pasta mixed with dry ingredients that, when reconstituted with liquid, will form a cream-style dish. Includes mixes described as carbonara or sour cream style. Typical ingredients include pasta, cheese, whey and skim milk powder, salt, spices and colours.

foods.name: Pasta in cream based sauce, prepared from dry mix
foods.description: Pasta dish prepared from a commercial dry mix by the addition of reduced fat milk, water and margarine spread, according to package instructions.

foods.name: Lasagne, beef, commercial, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially prepared pasta dish made from layers of minced beef, tomato sauce filling, savoury white cheese sauce and pasta. Purchased frozen, then baked at home before consumption.

foods.name: Lasagne, beef, homemade
foods.description: Home prepared pasta dish made from layers of pasta, bolognese sauce with added vegetables, savoury white cheese sauce and cheese (typically cheddar/mozzarella/parmesan).

foods.name: Macaroni & cheese, homemade, cooked unfilled pasta, homemade cheese sauce
foods.description: Home prepared pasta dish made from macaroni pasta, and a cheese based sauce commonly containing cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, cream and milk.

foods.name: Pasta dish, homemade, cooked unfilled pasta, homemade beef bolognese sauce & added vegetables
foods.description: Home prepared pasta dish described as spaghetti bolognese made using cooked unfilled pasta and a homemade beef bolognese sauce with or without added vegetables.

foods.name: Spaghetti in tomato & cheese sauce, canned
foods.description: Commercially prepared canned pasta product containing spaghetti in tomato and cheese sauce.

foods.name: Spaghetti in tomato & cheese sauce, canned, reduced salt
foods.description: Commercially prepared canned pasta product containing spaghetti in a reduced salt tomato and cheese sauce.

foods.name: Croissant, plain
foods.description: Commercially prepared crescent-shaped pastry prepared from ingredients such as wheat flour, butter, yeast, sugar, egg, milk powder and food additives, then baked. Sodium content likely to vary widely depending on ingredients.

foods.name: Pastry, filo, commercial, raw
foods.description: Uncooked commercial thin sheets of wheat flour based pastry, prepared without added fat, used in preparation of strudels and Greek-style pastry dishes.

foods.name: Pastry, filo, commercial, baked
foods.description: Baked commercial thin sheets of wheat flour based pastry, prepared without added fat, used in preparation of strudels and Greek-style pastry dishes.

foods.name: Pastry, puff, with butter, commercial, raw
foods.description: Uncooked pastry purchased ready-to-cook from supermarkets. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, butter, salt, citric acid and preservative.

foods.name: Pastry, puff, with butter, commercial, baked
foods.description: Pastry purchased uncooked from supermarkets and then baked at home. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, butter, salt, citric acid and preservative.

foods.name: Pastry, puff, vegetable oil, commercial, raw
foods.description: Uncooked pastry purchased ready-to-cook from supermarkets. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt, citric acid and preservative.

foods.name: Pastry, puff, vegetable oil, commercial, baked
foods.description: Pastry purchased uncooked from supermarkets and then baked at home. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt, citric acid and preservative.

foods.name: Pastry, shortcrust style, commercial, raw
foods.description: Uncooked pastry purchased in thin sheets or blocks from supermarkets. Produces a firm pastry often used on the base of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable fat, glycerol, citric acid and water.

foods.name: Pastry, shortcrust style, commercial, baked
foods.description: Pastry purchased in thin sheets or blocks from supermarkets and baked at home. Produces a firm pastry often used on the base of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable fat, glycerol, citric acid and water.

foods.name: Pastry, filled with spinach & cheese, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially prepared savoury filo pastry product enclosing a filling of spinach and cheese (generally ricotta or feta).

foods.name: Pie, savoury, chicken & vegetable, commercial
foods.description: Commercially produced chicken and vegetable based filling enclosed in pastry, purchased frozen or ready to eat.

foods.name: Pie, savoury, meat, commercial, ready to eat
foods.description: Commercially prepared meat-based (usually beef and/or mutton) filling enclosed in pastry, purchased ready to eat.

foods.name: Pie, savoury, meat, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially prepared meat-based (usually beef and/or mutton) filling enclosed pastry, purchased frozen and baked at home.

foods.name: Sausage roll, commercial, ready to eat
foods.description: Commercially prepared meat filling (usually beef and/or lamb) rolled in pastry, purchased ready to eat.

foods.name: Sausage roll, purchased frozen, baked
foods.description: Commercially prepared meat filling (usually beef and/or lamb) rolled in pastry, purchased frozen, and baked at home.

foods.name: Spring roll, meat & vegetable filling, commercial, deep fried
foods.description: Commercially prepared meat and/or vegetable filling rolled in thin pastry, which has been deep fried. Includes spring rolls purchased frozen and served in takeaway food outlets.

foods.name: Pastry, danish, sweet, all types
foods.description: Commercially prepared, or home made puff-style flaky pastry folded around fruit, nut and custard fillings.

foods.name: Pie, sweet, apple, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared apple filling enclosed in sweet short crust pastry. Purchased ready to eat.

foods.name: Tart, custard, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared shortcrust pastry shell with a custard filling.

foods.name: Dressing, French or Italian, regular fat, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared thin sauce used to dress salads. Major ingredients include water, vegetable oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic and spices.

foods.name: Dressing, thousand island, regular fat, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared thick white, beige or light orange coloured cream, emulsified sauce used to dress salads and seafood. Major ingredients include vegetable oil, vinegar, milk powder, tomato, sugar, egg and seasonings.

foods.name: Mayonnaise, traditional (>65% fat), commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared white, emulsified sauce with a similar thick consistency to cream. Used in sandwiches or to dress salads. Major ingredients include oil, sugar, vinegar and egg.

foods.name: Mayonnaise, low fat, commercial
foods.description: A white, emulsified sauce with a similar thick consistency to cream, using lower levels of oil to develop a product with a low fat content. Used in sandwiches and to dress salads. Major ingredients include oil, sugar and vinegar.

foods.name: Gravy powder, dry mix
foods.description: Dry mix for reconstitution as sauce to be served with meat. Typical ingredients may include wheat flour, salt, colour, spices and vegetable protein.

foods.name: Gravy, prepared from dry powder with water
foods.description: Gravy powder prepared with water, according to packet instructions. Typical ingredients may include wheat flour, salt, colour, spices and vegetable protein.

foods.name: Mustard, cream style
foods.description: Yellowish paste prepared from ground mustard seeds (typically 10 - 30% of total product), water, vinegar, salt and herbs or other spices. Sold packaged in jars and used as a condiment without further preparation.

foods.name: Paste, Indian style curry, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared Indian style curry paste sauce. Ingredients may include water, tomato and onion puree, vegetable oil, chilli, garlic, ginger, herbs & spices and colours and flavourings.

foods.name: Paste, green curry, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared paste containing green chilli, onions, salt, spices, herbs, vegetable oil and other ingredients, used for preparing south-east Asian style main dishes.

foods.name: Paste, soybean
foods.description: A thick paste made from fermented and processed soya beans mixed with grain and injected with a yeast mould.

foods.name: Paste, shrimp
foods.description: Commercially prepared dark, pungent paste prepared from shrimp and used as a flavouring in Asian style cooking.

foods.name: Sauce, barbecue, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet, thick, brown coloured, bottled sauce containing apples, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, golden syrup, food acid, thickener, salt, molasses, mixed citrus peel, raisins, spices, vegetable gum and water.

foods.name: Sauce, butter chicken, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared Indian style butter chicken sauce. Commonly contains water, tomatoes, onions, vegetable oil, cream, butter, sugar, salt, spices, garlic, chilli and colour.

foods.name: Sauce, cranberry, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared jellied or semi-jellied sweet jam-like sauce made from cranberries, sugars and water.

foods.name: Sauce, fish, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce based on fish or anchovy extract, and salt, commonly used in Asian style cooking.

foods.name: Sauce, hoi sin (hoisin), commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sweet, spicy bottled sauce based on fermented soya beans with other ingredients.

foods.name: Sauce, oyster, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce based on oyster extract, sugar, caramel, salt, starch, flavour, protein or hydrolysed vegetable protein, soy sauce, preservative, sodium benzoate, water, food conditioner. Commonly used in Asian-style cooking.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta or simmer, commercial, low fat
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce for use as a simmer/pasta bake sauce, formulated so as to contain less than 3% fat. Typical ingredients include water, thickener, cheese, onion, garlic, salt, flavours, herbs and spices.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta, basil pesto, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared basil pesto flavoured pasta sauce. Commonly containing basil, vegetable and /or olive oil, cashews, pine nuts, water, cheese, sugar, salt and garlic.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta, bolognese, homemade using beef mince & homemade tomato based sauce
foods.description: Home prepared savoury sauce made from beef mince and other ingredients such as onion, garlic, oil, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, pepper, herbs and occasionally wine. May contain vegetables such as mushroom, carrot, zucchini and red capsicum. Does not contain added salt and sugar.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta, bolognese, homemade using beef mince & commercial tomato based sauce
foods.description: Home prepared savoury sauce made from beef mince and other ingredients including onion, garlic, oil and a commercial tomato based sauce. Commonly served with pasta.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta, cheese or cream-based, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared creamy pasta sauce containing water, cream and/or cheese, thickener, vegetable oil, flavours, salt, herbs and spices. Different flavoured sauces may also contain vegetables, and/or meat products.

foods.name: Sauce, pasta, tomato-based, commercial, heated
foods.description: Commercially prepared tomato-based pasta sauce with herbs, spices and vegetables for addition to pasta dishes. Heated without added ingredients according to label instructions.

foods.name: Sauce, plum, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared chutney-style, spicy, sweet, hot sauce, based on plums.

foods.name: Sauce, rogan josh, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared Indian style Rogan Josh flavoured sauce. Commonly contains water, vegetable oil, salt, coriander, ginger, chilli, spices, gram flour and pepper.

foods.name: Sauce, salsa, tomato-based, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared Mexican style, tomato based dip. Typical ingredients include tomato, onion, capsicum, jalapenos, salt and chilli.

foods.name: Sauce, simmer for chicken, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared simmer/bake sauce intended for use with chicken dishes. Typical base ingredients  include water, vegetable oil, onion, thickener, flavours, herbs and spices. Additional ingredients may be included depending on the flavour of the simmer sauce.

foods.name: Sauce, simmer, curry flavoured, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared simmer style sauce suitable for pouring over chicken or beef to produce an Indian-style curry.

foods.name: Sauce, soy, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared dark brown salty liquid sauce commonly containing hydrolysed soy protein, hydrolysed wheat protein, salt, colour (caramel) and water.

foods.name: Sauce, soy, commercial, reduced salt
foods.description: Commercially prepared dark brown, salty, liquid sauce commonly containing hydrolysed soy protein, hydrolysed wheat protein, salt, colour (caramel) and water. Reduced in salt compared to regular soy sauce.

foods.name: Sauce, tabasco, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared spicy sauce made from red peppers.

foods.name: Sauce, tomato, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.

foods.name: Sauce, tomato, commercial, reduced salt
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency formulated to have less added salt than regular commercial tomato sauce. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.

foods.name: Sauce, tomato, reduced sugar & salt, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency formulated to have less added sugar and salt than regular commercial tomato sauce. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.

foods.name: Sauce, white, savoury, homemade
foods.description: Home prepared creamy style sauce made in the home from  butter, white wheat flour and milk.

foods.name: Sauce, Worcestershire, commercial
foods.description: Commercially prepared fermented liquid condiment made with vinegar, molasses, golden syrup, salt, water, spices, soy sauce, pepper, tamarinds, anchovies, lemon oil, onion and garlic powder.

foods.name: Vinegar (except balsamic vinegar)
foods.description: Sour liquid prepared by acetous fermentation, with or without alcoholic fermentation, of any suitable foodstuff, commonly used in dressings. Available types of vinegar include white, brown and malt.

foods.name: Vinegar, balsamic
foods.description: Sour liquid prepared by acetous fermentation. Balsamic vinegar is based on wine vinegar complemented by concentrated and cooked grape must, ageing allowing aroma to further develop. Commonly used in dressings and as a taste enhancer in various recipes

foods.name: Peanut butter, smooth & crunchy, added sugar & salt
foods.description: Commercial paste made from roasted and ground peanuts. Available in two types with (crunchy) and without (smooth) chunks of peanuts. Contains vegetable oil, added sugar and salt.

foods.name: Peanut butter, smooth & crunchy, no added sugar or salt
foods.description: Commercial paste made from roasted, unsalted and ground peanuts. Available in two types with (crunchy) and with out (smooth) chunks of peanuts. Does not contain added salt or sugar.

foods.name: Spread, yeast, marmite
foods.description: Commercial thick, dark brown concentrated yeast extract spread. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.

foods.name: Spread, yeast, vegemite
foods.description: Commercial, thick dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.

foods.name: Cheese, blue vein
foods.description: Prepared by the addition of culture, rennet and mould spores to cows milk to produce green, grey, blue or black spots of mould throughout the body of the cheese. Includes Australian and imported blue cheese.

foods.name: Cheese, bocconcini
foods.description: Fresh, soft cheese made from cows milk. Sold shaped into small balls and packed in brine or water.

foods.name: Cheese, brie
foods.description: Australian and imported soft cheese covered with white mould and labelled as being brie style or double brie. Prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cows milk prior to salting and curing.

foods.name: Cheese, camembert
foods.description: Prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cows milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft creamy surface ripened cheese. Includes Australian and imported soft cheese covered with white mould and labelled as being camembert style.

foods.name: Cheese, cheddar, natural, regular fat
foods.description: Cheddar cheese prepared by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard pale yellow cheese. Includes unsliced mild, tasty and vintage varieties.

foods.name: Cheese, cheddar, natural, reduced fat (~25%)
foods.description: Cheddar cheese prepared by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard pale yellow cheese. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 25%.

foods.name: Cheese, cheddar, processed, regular fat
foods.description: Commercially prepared regular fat processed cheddar cheese. Prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied as slices or blocks.

foods.name: Cheese, cheddar, processed, reduced fat (~15%), added vitamin D
foods.description: Commercially prepared processed cheddar cheese formulated to contain approximately 16% fat. Prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt and vitamin D to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied as slices or blocks.

foods.name: Cheese, cottage
foods.description: Regular fat creamed cottage cheese, prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cows milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese.

foods.name: Cheese, cream, plain
foods.description: Regular fat soft, white cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cows milk, cream and vegetable gum.

foods.name: Cheese, edam
foods.description: A semi-hard cheese made by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing. Coated in oil or a red or yellow wax film. Includes Australian and imported edam cheese.

foods.name: Cheese, fetta (feta)
foods.description: Made by curdling cows milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and stored in either whey or brine. Includes Australian and imported fetta cheese.

foods.name: Cheese, goat, firm
foods.description: Cheese made from goats milk. Firm in texture.

foods.name: Cheese, goat, soft
foods.description: Cheese made from goats milk. Soft in texture.

foods.name: Cheese, haloumi (halloumi)
foods.description: Salty, semi-soft cheese that maintains its texture when cooked.

foods.name: Cheese, haloumi (halloumi), reduced salt
foods.description: Salty, semi-soft cheese that maintains its texture when cooked. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular haloumi.

foods.name: Cheese, mozzarella
foods.description: Cheese made from cows milk with a rubbery texture. Typically added to pizza and other Italian-style dishes.

foods.name: Cheese, parmesan, dried, finely grated
foods.description: Parmesan-style cheese, prepared by removing the majority of cream from cows milk before heating, curdling and brining. Cheese is finely grated prior to sale and some additional moisture may be removed, so that the cheese does not generally require refrigerator storage.

foods.name: Cheese, parmesan, fresh, regular fat
foods.description: A hard granular cheese prepared by removing the majority of cream from cows milk before heating, curdling and brining.

foods.name: Cheese, ricotta
foods.description: Australian produced ricotta cheese. Prepared by collecting the whey from the coagulation of cows milk and further separation and draining.

foods.name: Cheese, hard, dairy alternative
foods.description: Commercially produced dairy cheese alternative with a firm texture and cheese like appearance. Products consist of water, vegetable oils, starch, salt, natural flavours and colourings, and may contain added calcium.

foods.name: Cream, thickened, regular fat (~35%)
foods.description: Australian produced thickened cream with a fat content of 35%. Major ingredients include cream, gelatine and vegetable gum. Produced by separating milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk) and adding thickener to increase the viscosity.

foods.name: Cream, sour, regular fat
foods.description: Commercially produced Australian sour cream with a fat content of approximately 35% Prepared by culturing cream or milk with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour.

foods.name: Cream, sour, light (~18% fat)
foods.description: Commercially produced Australian sour cream with a fat content of approximately 18%. Prepared by culturing a combination of cows milk cream and milk with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour and decreased fat content compared to regular sour cream.

foods.name: Cream, imitation (non-dairy)
foods.description: Commercially produced soft product with a creamy appearance and texture that is commonly used in baked goods in place of whipped dairy cream, but which is not dairy-based.

foods.name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, regular fat
foods.description: Commercial product prepared by mixing milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream to give it a light texture. Includes varieties with a fat content of 11%. Some analysed samples contain egg yolk.

foods.name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, premium or rich (~15% fat)
foods.description: Vanilla ice cream. Major ingredients include cream, milk, sugar, gums and emulsifiers. Prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture. Includes premium and gourmet ice creams with fat content ~15%. Some samples contain egg yolk.

foods.name: Ice confection, stick, milk-based, various flavours
foods.description: Frozen flavoured ice confection typically made from sugar, skim milk/solids, whey and vegetable gums, sold on a stick. Include strawberry, banana and rainbow flavours.

foods.name: Ice confection, stick, water-based, various flavours
foods.description: Frozen water based ice confection made from sugar, food acid, vegetable gum, flavour and colour, sold on a stick.

foods.name: Ice confection, stick or tub, fruit juice or fruit flavoured
foods.description: Frozen fruit juice or fruit flavoured ice confection. typically made from sugar and fruit juices such as lemon, pineapple, passionfruit and orange. Frozen prior to sale and sold on a stick or in a tube. One of four samples does not contain fruit juice.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, regular fat (~3.5%)
foods.description: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Supplied with a minimum fat content of 3.2 g milk fat/100 g.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, prepared from dry powder, regular fat, standard dilution
foods.description: Cows milk prepared by mixing regular fat milk powder with water according to label directions as consumed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Survey.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, regular fat (~3.5%), added omega 3 polyunsaturates
foods.description: Australian produced regular fat cows milk to which sources of omega-3 fatty acids are added. Supplied with fat content of approximately 3.4%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, reduced fat (~1%)
foods.description: Australian produced reduced fat cows milk. Supplied with fat content of approximately 1%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, reduced fat (~1.5%), added omega 3 polyunsaturates
foods.description: Australian produced reduced fat cows milk. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 1%, with added sources of omega-3 fatty acids.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, skim (~0.15% fat)
foods.description: Australian produced cows skim milk. Supplied with a maximum fat content of 0.15%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, prepared from dry powder, skim, standard dilution
foods.description: Cows milk prepared by mixing skim milk powder with water according to label directions as consumed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Survey.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, lactose free, regular fat (~3.5%)
foods.description: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Supplied with a fat content of 3.5%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, lactose free, reduced fat (~1%)
foods.description: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Supplied with a fat content of 1%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, canned, evaporated, regular
foods.description: Canned milk prepared by evaporating approximately 60% of the water content of regular fat cows milk prior to sterilisation.

foods.name: Milk, cow, canned, evaporated, reduced fat (~2%)
foods.description: Canned milk prepared by evaporating approximately 60% of the water content of regular fat and skim cows milk prior to sterilisation. Formulated to have a fat content of 2%.

foods.name: Milk, cow, canned, sweetened, condensed, regular
foods.description: Milk product prepared by adding sugar to regular fat cows milk prior to evaporation of approximately 50% of the water content. Includes both canned and tube varieties.

foods.name: Milk, cow, fluid, flavoured, chocolate, reduced fat
foods.description: Reduced fat cows milk (1-2% milk fat) with added cocoa powder, sugar and flavours.

foods.name: Milk, cow, powder, regular fat
foods.description: Regular fat cows milk powder, prepared by removing water from regular fat milk by spray-drying. May also contain lecithin. Includes fortified and unfortified varieties.

foods.name: Milk, cow, powder, regular fat, unfortified
foods.description: Regular fat cows milk powder, prepared by removing water from regular fat milk by spray-drying. May also contain lecithin.

foods.name: Milk, cow, powder, regular fat, added vitamins A & D
foods.description: Regular fat cows milk powder, prepared by removing water from regular fat milk by spray-drying. Contains added vitamins A and D. May also contain lecithin.

foods.name: Milk, cow, powder, skim
foods.description: Cows skim milk powder, prepared by removing the majority of water from skim cows milk by spray drying.

foods.name: Milk, human/breast, mature, fluid
foods.description: Mammary secretion of human mothers.

foods.name: Custard, vanilla, regular fat
foods.description: Commercially produced regular fat vanilla flavoured custard. Major ingredients include regular fat milk, sugar, flavour and thickener. Custard does not contain eggs.

foods.name: Custard powder, vanilla, dry mix
foods.description: Dry yellow powder used for making custard. Ingredients include cornflour, salt, colours and flavours.

foods.name: Custard, vanilla, prepared from dry mix
foods.description: Vanilla custard prepared from commercial vanilla custard powder according to packet instructions.

foods.name: Yoghurt, natural, regular fat (~3%)
foods.description: Unflavoured (natural) yoghurt. Prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cows milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Contains added milk powder. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 4%. Does not contain fruit or flavouring.

foods.name: Yoghurt, natural, sheep's milk
foods.description: Sheep's milk yoghurt. Prepared by pasteurising and homogenising sheep's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt.

foods.name: Yoghurt, flavoured, high fat (~5%)
foods.description: Yoghurt that is sweetened and flavoured. Prepared by culturing cows milk and cream, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. May contain fruit pieces or puree. Formulated to have a fat content of greater than 5%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, apricot pieces or flavoured, regular fat (~3%)
foods.description: Yoghurt with apricot pieces or flavour and added sugar. Prepared by culturing regular fat cows milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 3%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, strawberry pieces or flavoured, regular fat (~3%)
foods.description: Yoghurt with strawberry pieces or flavour and added sugar. Prepared by culturing regular fat cows milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 3%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, flavoured, low fat (~2%)
foods.description: Yoghurt that is sweetened and flavoured. Prepared by culturing regular fat cows milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. May contain fruit pieces or puree. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 2%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, vanilla flavoured (~2%)
foods.description: Yoghurt that is sweetened and flavoured with vanilla. Prepared by culturing regular fat cows milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 2%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, flavoured, low fat (0.2%), intense sweetened, increased protein
foods.description: Low fat yoghurt that is intense-sweetened. Prepared by culturing low fat milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Formulated to have a fat content of <0.5%, and to be higher in protein than regular yoghurt.

foods.name: Yoghurt, vanilla flavoured, low fat (<0.5%)
foods.description: Low fat yoghurt that is sweetened and flavoured with vanilla. Prepared by culturing low fat milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Formulated to have a fat content of less than 0.5%.

foods.name: Yoghurt, almond based, flavoured
foods.description: Non-dairy yoghurt that is based on almond milk, with added fruit flavours.

foods.name: Yoghurt, coconut based, flavoured
foods.description: Non-dairy yoghurt that is based on coconut milk, with added flavours such as fruit and vanilla.

foods.name: Yoghurt, soy based, berry flavoured, regular fat (~3%)
foods.description: Yoghurt-style sweet product based on soy milk rather than dairy milk, with added berry flavour and formulated to have a fat content of approximately 3%..

foods.name: Yoghurt, soy based, vanilla flavoured, reduced fat (~1%)
foods.description: Yoghurt-style sweet product based on soy milk rather than dairy milk, with added vanilla flavour and formulated to have a fat content of approximately 1%.

foods.name: Dairy or yoghurt dessert, chocolate, regular fat
foods.description: Commercially prepared, dairy product flavoured with chocolate and intended for use as a child's dessert. Typical ingredients include milk, sugar, cocoa, vegetable gums, salt, thickeners, emulsifiers and flavours.

foods.name: Almond beverage, added sugar, unfortified
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sweetened with sugar or rice syrup.

foods.name: Almond beverage, no added sugar, unfortified
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sunflower oil and salt. Does not contain added sugar or calcium.

foods.name: Almond beverage, added sugar & Ca
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sunflower oil and salt. Product is sweetened with added sugar or syrup, and contains added calcium.

foods.name: Almond beverage, no added sugar, added Ca
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds and salt. Does not contain added sugar but does contain added calcium.

foods.name: Almond beverage, added sugar & vitamins B1, B2, B12, C & Ca
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sweetened with sugar. Contains added sugar and vitamins B1, B2, B12 and calcium.

foods.name: Coconut beverage, unfortified
foods.description: Coconut beverage, commonly used as a milk alternative. Major ingredients include water and 8-20% coconut milk or cream. Unfortified.

foods.name: Coconut beverage, added Ca
foods.description: Coconut beverage, commonly used as a milk alternative. Major ingredients include water and 8-20% coconut milk or cream. Contains added calcium but not added sugar.

foods.name: Oat beverage, fluid, unfortified
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from filtered water, oats, sunflower oil and salt, without added vitamins and minerals.

foods.name: Oat beverage, fluid, added Ca
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from filtered water, oats, sunflower oil and salt. Contains added calcium.

foods.name: Oat beverage, fluid, added calcium & vitamins
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from filtered water, oats, sunflower oil and salt, without added vitamins and minerals.

foods.name: Rice beverage, unfortified
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from filtered water, brown rice, sunflower oil and salt. Does not contain added calcium.

foods.name: Rice beverage, fluid, added calcium
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute made from filtered water, brown rice, sunflower oil and salt. Contains added calcium.

foods.name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), unfortified
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute prepared from soy beans with a fat content of 3%. Does not contain added vitamins, minerals or artificial flavouring substances.

foods.name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), added Ca
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute prepared from soy beans with a fat content of 3%. Contains added calcium.

foods.name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), added Ca & vitamins A, B1, B2 & B12
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute prepared from soy beans with a fat content of 3%. Contains added calcium and vitamins A, B1, B2 and B12.

foods.name: Soy beverage, reduced fat (~1%), added Ca & vitamins A, B1, B2 & B12
foods.description: A dairy milk substitute prepared from soy beans with a reduced fat content of ~1%. Contains added calcium, potassium, magnesium, vitamins A, B1, B2, B12 and D.

foods.name: Textured vegetable protein/soy granules
foods.description: Textured vegetable protein is a defatted soy flour product, a by-product of extracting soybean oil. It is often used as a meat analogue or meat extender.

foods.name: Tofu (soy bean curd), firm, as purchased
foods.description: Commercially prepared soy bean extract, that has set to a firm texture. Ingredients include water, soy beans, glucono-delta lactone, and nigari (magnesium chloride) or calcium salts.

foods.name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, commercial, as purchased
foods.description: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) formed as pieces, fillets, strips and/or mince. Also contain flavours, and/or seasoning.

foods.name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, schnitzels/fish alternative/patty/sausages, as purchased
foods.description: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) mixed with flour, and/or other vegetable proteins and breadcrumbs to form schnitzel, crumbed fish alternative, patty and sausage products. Also contain flavours, and/or seasoning.

foods.name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, cooked
foods.description: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) formed as pieces, fillets, strips and/or mince. Also contain flavours, and/or seasoning. Cooked after purchase.

foods.name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, as purchased
foods.description: Meat alternative products commonly based on soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties.

foods.name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, cooked
foods.description: Meat alternative products commonly based on soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties. Cooked without added fat after purchase.

foods.name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, added vitamins & minerals, as purchased
foods.description: Meat alternative products commonly based on soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties.

foods.name: Meat alternative, legume and/or vegetable base, as purchased
foods.description: Meat alternative products made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Formed into burgers/patties.

foods.name: Meat alternative, legume and/or vegetable base, cooked
foods.description: Meat alternative products made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Formed into burgers/patties. Cooked after purchase.

foods.name: Sausage, vegetarian style, unfortified, raw
foods.description: Sausages made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

foods.name: Sausage, vegetarian style, added Fe, Zn and vitamin B12, raw
foods.description: Sausages made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Contains added iron, zinc and vitamin B12.

foods.name: Sausage, vegetarian style, fried, no added fat
foods.description: Sausages made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. May contain added iron, zinc and vitamin B12. Cooked by frying with out added fat.

foods.name: Soup, broth style, with meat, instant dry mix
foods.description: Instant dry beef mix soup containing beef or chicken and other ingredients such as spices and herbs, maltodextrins, salt and starch. Requires mixing with boiling water in a cup before consumption.

foods.name: Soup, broth style, with meat & noodles, instant dry mix
foods.description: Instant dry chicken noodle soup mix containing noodles, salt, sugar, flavour enhancer, garlic, skim milk, vegetable fat, hydrolysed veg. protein, chicken, onion, parsley, spices, herbs, colour (turmeric). Requires mixing with boiling water in a cup before consumption.

foods.name: Soup, cream variety, instant dry mix
foods.description: Instant dry cream type soup mix including chicken, onion, mushroom and vegetable flavours. Typical ingredients include chicken, dried onions, mushrooms, purees of potato, carrot, leak, wheat flour, green bean, swede, salt, non-fat milk solids, beef fat, vegetable protein, herbs and spices, maltodextrin, flavours and enhancers. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

foods.name: Soup, vegetable, instant dry mix
foods.description: Dry onion soup mix containing dried onion and other ingredients such as mushrooms, herbs, wheat flour, vegetable oil, beverage whitener, milk proteins, salt and vegetable gum. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

foods.name: Soup, vegetable & noodle, instant dry mix
foods.description: Instant tomato soup dry mix with noodles, containing tomato powder, wheat gluten, beverage whitener, vegetable oil, antioxidants, maize starch, maltodextrin, salt and spices. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

foods.name: Soup, chicken & noodle, cup of soup, prepared from instant dry mix with water
foods.description: Chicken noodle soup prepared from instant dry soup mix by mixing with boiling tap water according to label instructions.

foods.name: Butter, plain, salted
foods.description: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of an emulsion of the type water-in-oil, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Contains added salt.

foods.name: Butter, plain, reduced salt
foods.description: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of an emulsion of the type water-in-oil, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Reduced in salt compared to regular butter.

foods.name: Butter, plain, no added salt
foods.description: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of an emulsion of the type water-in-oil, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Does not contain added salt.

foods.name: Ghee, clarified butter
foods.description: Indian-style clarified butter containing at least 99.7% milk fat, used mainly in cooking.

foods.name: Dairy blend, butter & edible oil spread (~80% fat), sodium 600 mg/100 g
foods.description: A spread that is a blend of approximately two-thirds butter and one-third vegetable oil, generally canola oil, with a fat content of approximately 80%. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Dairy blend, butter & edible oil spread (~80% fat), reduced salt (sodium 400 mg/100 g)
foods.description: A spread that is a blend of approximately two-thirds butter and one-third vegetable oil, generally canola oil with a fat content of approximately 80%. Contains a lower salt content than regular dairy blend and added vitamin D. May contain added vitamin A.

foods.name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated (>65% fat)
foods.description: A monounsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 65%  or more edible oils including canola oil, olive oil or blends of monounsaturated oils. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated (>65% fat), reduced salt (sodium 360 mg/100 g)
foods.description: A monounsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 65% monounsaturated edible oils including canola oil, olive oil or blends of monounsaturated oils. Formulated to have a reduced salt content. Contains added vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, reduced fat (<65%)
foods.description: A monounsaturated edible oil spread containing less than 65% edible oils including canola oil, olive oil or blends of monounsaturated oils. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, reduced fat (~55%) & salt (sodium 380 mg/100 g)
foods.description: A monounsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 55% monounsaturated edible oils including canola oil, olive oil or blends of monounsaturated oils. Formulated to have a reduced salt content. Contains added vitamins A and D

foods.name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated (~70% fat), reduced salt (sodium 350 mg/100 g), added phytosterols
foods.description: A monounsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 70% monounsaturated edible oils including canola oil, olive oil or blends of monounsaturated oils. Formulated to have a reduced salt content. Contains added vitamins A and D and phytosterols.

foods.name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated (~70% fat)
foods.description: A polyunsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 70% fat, the majority of which are polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated (~70% fat), reduced salt (sodium 280 mg/100 g)
foods.description: A polyunsaturated edible oil spread containing approximately 70% polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Formulated to have a reduced salt content. Contains added vitamins A and D.

foods.name: Oil, almond
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the almond (Prunus amygdalus).

foods.name: Oil, avocado
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the pulp of avocados (Persea americana).

foods.name: Oil, canola
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the canola plant (Brassica napus or Brassica campestris). Although derived from the same plant, canola oil is not rapeseed oil, and it is distinguished by low levels of erucic acid.

foods.name: Oil, coconut
foods.description: An edible oil derived from the flesh and milk of the coconut palm (Cocos nucifera) fruit. The oil is white and solid at room temperature.

foods.name: Oil, copha
foods.description: Solidified edible oil extracted from the coconut and used in baking.

foods.name: Oil, cottonseed
foods.description: Edible oil derived from the seeds of the cotton plant.

foods.name: Oil, grapeseed
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of grapes.

foods.name: Oil, hemp
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the ripened fruits (seeds) of the hemp plant (Cannabis sativa). Refined or unrefined, cold pressed.

foods.name: Oil, linseed or flaxseed
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from linseeds/flaxseeds.

foods.name: Oil, macadamia
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the macadamia nut (Macadamia integrifolia).

foods.name: Oil, maize
foods.description: Edible oil obtained from the kernel of corn or maize (Zea mays).

foods.name: Oil, mustard seed
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the mustard plant (Sinapsis alba and Brassica nigra).

foods.name: Oil, olive
foods.description: Edible oil pressed from the flesh of the fruit of the olive tree (Olea europaea).

foods.name: Oil, palm
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the oil palm.

foods.name: Oil, peanut
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the kernel of the peanut (Leguminosae Arachis hypogaea L.).

foods.name: Oil, rice bran
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the bran of the rice kernel.

foods.name: Oil, safflower
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the safflower plant (Carthamus tinctorius).

foods.name: Oil, sesame
foods.description: Dark-coloured oil extracted from toasted sesame seeds, used as a flavouring agent in Asian style cooking.

foods.name: Oil, soybean
foods.description: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the soybean plant (Glycine maximus).

foods.name: Oil, sunflower
foods.description: Edible oil obtained from the seed of the sunflower plant (Helianthus annuus).

foods.name: Oil, blend of polyunsaturated vegetable oils
foods.description: Edible oil composed of a mixture, or blend, of various polyunsaturated vegetable oils available in 2008. Blend composition in the analysed samples may not represent those available at other times. Oil may contain antioxidant.

foods.name: Oil, blend of monounsaturated vegetable oils
foods.description: Edible oil composed of a mixture, or blend, of various monounsaturated vegetable oils available in 2008. Blend composition in the analysed samples may not represent those available at other times. Oil may contain antioxidant.
